Alright, this is probably the final update on testing shield modifiers since I'm getting bored.
Updated formula, it's a bit of a mess since there are many different modifiers.
Final shield = ([base shield] * [sum of specific command card base shield%+1] * [sum of general command card base shield%+1] * [sum of general base shield%+1]+ [Base Shield add]) * [sum of party shield%+1] * [sum of final shield%+1] * [sum of other final shield%+1]

Categories (every bonus with a category is added together):
Specific command card base shield%: Examples: Core Meltdown, Feast, Active bonus from Will Unyielding, Land of Nonexistence
General command card base shield%:  Examples: Paradox Covenant, Data is Flesh SR, The Last Verse, Never-Ending Performance (buff), 35 mm magic SR. 
General base shield%: Examples: Will Unyielding passive bonus, Gaze of Izarawu, Memory Spiral, Unbearable Freedom, Pale Descendent, Shrouded Birth, Eternal Weave, Rota Fortunae, Cursed Rabbit covenant.
Base shield add: Examples: Alert, Fin of Sorrow.
Party shield%: Examples: Horla's Grief, Serpent's Husk Relic, Sanga Rouse (many untested abilities that probably should be here).
Final shield%: Examples: Fiamma, Singularity Prism. Probably PCaro buff (untested). 
Other final shield%: Examples: "Ablaze" buff from Pollux SSR wheel. (because why wouldn't there be another category for buffs specifically)

Maybe one of you can think of category names that are more clear, but these work for me. 

A few notes of interest:
Fin of Sorrow (Caecus SSR) adds directly to Base shield, like Alert but for just that Awakener. 
This means it doesn't scale with base shield% modifiers, but it *does* scale with all party shield and final shield modifiers. 
It will benefit from stuff like Sanga Rouse, Horla Grief, SUltra Beacon. 

Sanga Dimensional image, as you might expect, gets no benefit from any command card modifiers, but does benefit from all other modifiers including base shield add like Alert.
Sanga's SSR wheel (Death of ms. Coral) benefits from the same modifiers as her image, but only triggers once per turn obviously.
